description: This Java class 'Images' provides static arrays of image URLs and thumbnail URLs used as sample data in the Android application for displaying bitmaps. It serves as a data provider with no complex logic.

classes.name: Images
classes.description: A utility class containing static arrays of image URLs and thumbnails for sample data usage in the app.

methods.name: imageUrls
methods.description: Array of full-size image URLs used for loading images in the app.

methods.name: imageThumbUrls
methods.description: Array of thumbnail image URLs corresponding to the full-size images.
